name: TubeArchivist
description: Browse and watch your self-hosted TubeArchivist video library
author: TheFehr

authentication.loginWarning: This login is only used to unlock 'Import Subscriptions' below — the plugin already works without it, using the API token configured separately.

settings.name: Enable Debug Logging
settings.description: Enable detailed logging for debugging purposes

2: Fix Dropdown settings crashing on enable (value must be an index, not the raw string)
Fix config validation crash from a non-flat constants object
Fix thumbnails/subtitles failing to load (no way to attach auth headers to them natively; now routed through an auth-injecting proxy)
Remove unused/incorrect authentication block and claimType overrides
3: Add watched/progress sync: playback position is reported to TubeArchivist as you watch, so watched status stays in sync
4: Add Import Subscriptions support — sync TubeArchivist's subscribed channels into GrayJay in one tap, from the source's detail page
Requires a one-time login prompt (separate from the existing API token) to unlock the Import button
5: Fix login webview never closing — completionUrl was guessed at a page URL, but TubeArchivist's login redirect is client-side (no network request); now matches the actual login API call, which GrayJay's webview can observe
6: Sign the plugin script — removes the 'Missing Signature' warning on install/update
